newsitem.title: SWEDEN: AGA buys Polish state's AGA holding.
newsitem.headline: AGA buys Polish state's AGA holding.

text.p: Swedish gas company AGA on Monday said it had bought the remaining part of the Polish state's holding in its Polish unit, giving AGA 100 percent ownership of AGA Gaz Sp.z.o.o.
AGA said it had also acquired the acetylene operation from the Polish chemical company Rawent in Skiernewice, a town close to Warsaw.
AGA said its Polish unit, AGA Gaz Sp.z.o.o., operates two important production units for acetylene in the country.
"AGA operations in Poland show rapid growth and constitute an important part of AGA's expansion in Eastern Europe," AGA said in a statement.
